title: It's morning!
text: “A Big Filolial? Is there still someone else?”
There’s no doubt about it—Filo-tan doesn’t have that signature tuft of hair on her head. It seems you haven’t met my Father and the others yet.
“That’s right. When Filo-tan and Filolial-sama receive power from the Great Filolial, they’ll get a special Class Up, and their stats will improve significantly.”
“But I have to go to a place called Cal Mira Island starting tomorrow. What am I supposed to do without a Class Up?”
“We’ll handle that by using various weapon enhancement methods. I’ve got a few things going on starting tomorrow, so I’ll be delayed in heading to Cal Mira Island.”
“Enhancement methods again… With all those types already out there, are there still more? …I see. So there are enhancement methods for these so-called Seven Star Weapons, too?”
“That’s right.”

Just as I expected from Father. He’s able to extract information from even the slightest hint in my words. I’ll hand my Father a memo I just put together summarizing the enhancement methods for the Seven Star Weapons.

“Among the enhancement methods for this Seven Star Whip, there’s one that improves stats by sacrificing levels. If you use this, you can level up for a while without having to go through a Class Up. Also, since you might run into Filolial-sama while traveling on a ship or something, it’s a good idea to leave Cal Mira Island partway through to do a Class Up.”
The activation period is surprisingly long, so I think it’s best to take advantage of that.
I can see my Father fiddling with his controls while holding a note. After giving it some thought, he let out a deep sigh.
“It certainly is possible… With so many ways to enhance it, just how much of my time have I wasted?”
My Father is lamenting.
“However, I think you should go ahead and get the sand from the Dragon Hourglass. You can get the Portal Skill with it, after all.”
“Yeah, yeah. So this is how you enhance weapons… They call them the Seven Star Weapons, but there are eight of them—what kind of joke is that?”
“The eighth one is the carriage held by the great Filolial-sama. It seems to have been forgotten because it’s kept out of public view.”
“Ah… I see. I see. So, Motoyasu, are you trying to escape this loop?”
I’ll have to think about that now that my Father has asked. I’ve never really given it much thought.
“That’s my goal, for now. But I’m acting out of love. If that’s a problem, then so be it.”
“Ah… I see.”
“In other loops, you’ve looked into various things for me, but unfortunately, the mystery still hasn’t been solved at all.”
“The first loop ended when I met Filo, didn’t it…? Is that different from now, since I’ve already met Filo…? That must be tough.”
My father rests his elbows on the table and props his chin in his hands, looking exasperated.
“Anyway… when are you going to loop? If there’s possession or something, is there a chance you’ll go back to being the original Motoyasu?”

“At least as far as I can remember… I do have a vague recollection of things up until Father’s child was born and grew to a certain age. I even remember the child of Itsuki and that stalker pig. Honestly, I don’t really know when the loop happens.”
“I see. So you’re on such an uncertain journey… Wait, how old are you anyway?!”
“I’m The Love Hunter! I’m forever 21!”
I get the feeling that kind Fathers from all sorts of worlds are giving a wry smile in my head, but right now, I’m 21! Twenty-one!
“Sigh… You’ve turned into a real drain in a whole different way. Anyway, let’s get on with it. Assuming we’re going to level up on Cal Mira Island… what do we do after that?”

“I plan to take care of any problems that might arise down the road beforehand. Both Ren and Itsuki end up unsealing the Spirit Tortoise in the first world, but let’s ask Black Thunder and Fleon-chan to make sure that doesn’t happen. Even without it, we can manage to some extent.”
By the way, regarding the Spirit Tortoise materials—since we can still manage the Skills without them, substitutes are possible.
“The Spirit Tortoise… huh.”
“You said that line in other loops too, Father.”
“Oh, really?”
What a dismissive reply.
“Well, our reputation within the country is low, so we do plan to work on restoring that trust.”
It reminds me of what happened in the first world. Still, as long as the Spirit Tortoise’s seal isn’t broken, we can still make things work.
“After defeating the Spirit Tortoise, my father was given a fief and devoted himself to rebuilding my sister’s village. We’ll have to protect the villagers, too.”
“Hmm… Raphtalia’s hometown, is it…”
My father turns his gaze toward Big Sister at my words.
“That’s certainly not a bad idea. Even if it’s just a made-up story, we still need to create a place for Raphtalia to return to.”
“N-Naofumi-sama…”
Big Sister’s cheeks are turning red—perhaps she’s nervous.
“I plan to return to my original world eventually, after all.”
Big Sister looks a bit sad. I, Motoyasu, am not oblivious! Just like a male friend from middle school, I’ll put Big Sister’s mind at ease.
“Even though I say that, I’ll probably end up staying here most of the time.”
Father was like that when the loop started over, after all.
“Even if the me you knew was like that, it doesn’t mean I’ll be the same, does it?”
My Father looks slightly displeased.
“Uh, Spear Hero, please don’t provoke Naofumi-sama too much.”

My Big Sister cautions me, choosing her words carefully. My Father is so clueless! So let’s make it easy for him to understand. I, Motoyasu, feel like I’d be in trouble later if I don’t butter up Big Sister, so I’m going to do it.
“Well then, I’ll imitate a male friend from my middle school days and show my Father our friendship levels using hearts! This is my analysis!”
This is how I determined just how much each of them likes me. It was a bit crude, but it was very easy to understand.

First off, Big Sister is definitely a five-heart on a five-point scale. I’d say it’s safe to say my personal route with her is already set in stone. My Finacée might not agree, but she’s probably around four hearts. That’s rude, considering Filo-tan is here. As for Big Sister’s older sister… I wonder how she’d rate? Now that Big Sister is still alive, I feel like just showing her that I can eat a Lucor Fruit would get me five hearts. Of course, let’s make Filo-tan—and my Father—unconquerable! It’s a no-go! You absolutely cannot “conquer” your own daughter!

Huh? Come to think of it, there was that Tiger Girl… I’m pretty sure I promised to give her special treatment. With all due respect, I’d completely forgotten. What was it I was supposed to give her special treatment for again?

Ah, the lavish lifestyle of royalty, I see. Well, let’s bring the Tiger Girls over later to rub salt in Trash’s wounds. With the Crimson Swine’s crimes already coming to light, this will be the final blow.
“What’s the deal with your friend from middle school?! I’m way more curious about that!”
“Is that so strange? I’m just trying to help my Father find love.”
“You’re so annoying… I’m not interested in such nonsense!”
“Please don’t tease Naofumi-sama, the Spear Hero. It really puts me in a bind!”
My Big Sister asked me to. I guess I have no choice.
“That’s right! Raphtalia also has a mission to fight the waves. She has no intention of falling in love!”
“…Yes.”

Her agreement after that moment of silence is incredibly poignant. As for Motoyasu, I’ll concede that my Big Sister has a crush on Father. Filo-tan is out of the question, but a romance born from familial love is beautiful in its own way. I feel like Big Sister in my head is saying, “Please don’t stir things up unnecessarily!” but I’m probably just imagining it.
“Anyway, rebuilding Raphtalia’s hometown is what we’ll do on the island… but what comes after that?”
“I suppose we’ll end up facing the Waves, won’t we?”
If the Spirit Tortoise hadn’t been unsealed, the Phoenix and others wouldn’t have been revived either. That was made abundantly clear in the loop involving your Father’s trip to Shieldfreeden.
“If we keep facing the Waves steadily, they’ll eventually come to an end. The problem is that each Dragon Hourglass around the world shows a different time for the wave’s arrival.”

“I think the Queen said something along those lines. Shadow mentioned it in Zeltoble, too. Got it. It seems we’ve decided what to do for now, so as for this place called Cal Mira Island… should I bring Raphtalia’s older sister, Sadeena, along too?”
“That’s entirely up to you.”
“Raphtalia wants to see you, right?”
“I’d like to see him if I can…”
“Sigh… Well, I guess I have no choice. Motoyasu, can you get out of here now?”
Oh? My father is finally getting off his butt and standing up.
“I can.”
“Then take me and Raphtalia to Zeltoble. I’ll bring Sadeena along.”

And so, I took my Father to Zeltoble, went around the taverns, found her Big Sister, and we had quite a chat. Persuaded by Big Sister, her older sister immediately began preparing to leave. And so, we returned to Melromarc and decided to get a good night’s sleep at the castle.
The next morning.
“Good morning—it’s morning!”
Fleon-chan is flying around outside the castle, announcing the morning. What a heartwarming sight. She flutters down and perches on the castle spire, chirping away.
“What a lovely way to wake up!”
“It certainly is.”
Oh? The Queen called out to me as I was doing my morning stretches on the stone wall, watching Fleon-chan.
“The flying Filolial, which was supposed to be extinct… To see it with my own eyes… It’s truly moving…”
The Queen is absolutely fascinated by Fleon-chan. To be completely smitten by the legendary Filolial-sama—that’s just like the Queen, isn’t it?

“I heard from the old man who used to own the flying Filolial, Fleon, that the Spear Hero is now its owner… Given that she lost all her companions because of her foolish daughter, does the Spear Hero intend to treat that child as a combat asset?”
“I simply hope that Fleon-chan grows up healthy and strong.”
If Fleon-chan says she doesn’t want to fight, I won’t stop her. There are also Filolial-sama who are pacifists. After all, the Filolial-sama have always been averse to sadness.
“I see… Fleon will likely receive countless marriage proposals. She might even be targeted by Filolial brokers from all over the world… so she should take ample precautions.”
Filolial brokers, you say? Ah, those are the people who try to use the Filolial-sama for profit.
“Don’t worry. Unless the Hero is the owner, the Filolial-sama won’t become Queen or King.”

It’s the hardest thing for me when fakes like Takt are the ones raising them. By the way, according to my Father, who went to Shieldfreeden to investigate, the Filolial-sama don’t take a liking to reincarnated individuals.
“No, that’s not what I meant… but I’ve heard that the Heroes still have plenty of room to grow in power. I’d be grateful if you could really hone your skills on Cal Mira Island.”
So the Queen still can’t quite gauge my strength yet, I see. Either way, if anyone tries to do anything to Fleon-chan, I’ll deal with them myself!
“Understood. Well then, Your Majesty, see you later!”
After finishing my conversation with the Queen, I head toward my Father’s room.
“Ah, Motoyasu.”
It seems my Father is awake. He’s in the hallway with my Big Sister and her older sister.
“Master, good morning!　Mel-chan says it’s time to eat breakfast.”
And with that, Filo-tan came running over.
“Huh? Who’s that?”
“Oh, good morning. This is Raphtalia-chan’s Big Sister—her name is Sadeena. Nice to meet you!”
My Big Sister introduced herself to Filo-tan.
“Huh… my big sister’s older sister?”
“That’s right, Filo.”
“Really? When did she get here? I didn’t know, Filo-tan.”
“Well, yesterday, Motoyasu brought her here to pick this one up.”
As Father explains, Filo-tan turns her face toward me. Eek… Filo-tan is looking at me.
“Hmm?”
“G-good morning. How are you today?”
“How lovely! Hey, Master, did you go somewhere without telling Filo?”
“I told you that. You slept at Melty’s place too, so it’s fine, right?”
“Ehh… Also, Mel-chan said she wants to talk more with that kid, Fleon. Hey, Master, how can Filo learn to fly?”
“Apparently, that’s something you’re born with. Or maybe you can’t do it through Class Up or something?”
My Father is looking right at me.
“M-maybe she’ll be able to do it someday.”
“Really!? Filo—I want to be able to fly in the sky too!”
Fleon-chan is getting jealous of Filo-chan! And I have a feeling even my Finacée is smitten with Fleon-chan… This is dangerous! If this keeps up, Filo-tan will…!
“I’ll look into it. So please bear with me a little longer.”
